name: Lazare Osiashvili
description: Equestrian Operations Specialist & Certified FEI Steward. Active rider and certified Steward with broad operational expertise in show jumping course layout, arena aesthetics, and international tournament setup. Supporting the Equestrian Federation of Georgia since 2022, with direct experience co-hosting World Cup Qualifiers alongside elite international FEI Course Designers and Chief Stewards. Highly detail-oriented, hard-working, and passionate about maintaining the highest standards in equine sport.
